jobDescription:
🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role

We are looking for intellectually curious, highly motivated individuals to join us post grad in 2027. The most important skills you’ll need to have are making sound product decisions and shipping high-quality products fast. We look for engineers with great product instincts who can own whole projects from start to finish.

Job Duties

The engineering team operates with a high level of autonomy so we need to hire people we can trust. Your ability to make good trade-offs and exercise good judgment is essential to us. Some job duties include:

  • Building new features for users in our live-streams
  • Implementing growth tactics and strategies to scale our buyer and seller flows
  • Building systems at scale that help us deliver a high trust marketplace experience
  • Writing product or system development code
  • Designing, implementing, and operating our most critical and scalable services
  • Carefully evaluating the technical tradeoffs of every decision
  • Supporting features at every phase, from design through implementation and launch
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues, network, or service operations and quality.

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of one of our following hubs; Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, or Seattle

👋 You

People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.

As our next Engineer you should have some industry software engineering experience, plus:

  • Graduated with a CS or Software Engineering degree by Summer 2027
  • Problem solver and out-of-the-box thinker
  • Willing to take risks and build product and systems for 1M+ users
  • Capable of building scalable systems
  • Excellent product instincts. You first think about users rather than the best technical solution
  • You are known for shipping products and features lightning-fast
  • Ability to pick up on new technologies very quickly
  • Open to relocation to Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, or Seattle

🎁 Benefits

  • Generous Holiday and Time off Policy
  • Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Work From Home Support
    • Home office setup allowance
    • Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet
  • Care benefits
    • Monthly allowance for wellness
    • Annual allowance towards Childcare
    • Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses
  • Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally
  • Monthly allowance to dogfood the app
    • All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!).
  • Parental Leave
    • 16 weeks of paid parental leave + one month gradual return to work *company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence.
Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.

💛 EOE

Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.

Compensation Range: $155K - $160K

Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Connected Commerce - Proprietary Wallets team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
  • Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
  • Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
  • Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
  • Writes secure and high-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with limited guidance - Java / Spring Boot / Microservices / RestAPIs
  • Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
  • Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
  • Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Familiarity with modern front-end technologies – React.JS, Angular, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Exposure to cloud technologies – AWS EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, Lambdas
  • Database experience such as Postgres or Cassandra

About Us

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

About The Team

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer - Java

Overview

Mastercard’s Enterprise Credit Risk (ECR) team is seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer – Java Full Stack to design, build, and modernize applications that power credit decisioning, portfolio risk management, lender workflows, customer experiences, and analytics across Mastercard’s lending and risk ecosystem.

This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex business problems through technology and working across the full application stack. The successful candidate will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Architecture, and Data teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing applications that improve operational efficiency, simplify lending decisions, and create exceptional user experiences.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on Java backend expertise combined with modern frontend development experience, a passion for engineering excellence, and the ability to contribute to technical design and delivery across the application lifecycle.

This is a hybrid role based in O’Fallon, MO, requiring three days per week onsite.

Role

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable full-stack applications supporting Enterprise Credit Risk products and services.
  • Build secure, resilient, and highly available backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Framework.
  • Develop modern, responsive user interfaces using React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven integrations to enable scalable application architectures.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Risk SMEs, Architects, and Data teams to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design discussions, evaluating technologies and recommending solutions that improve application capabilities and maintainability.
  • Develop reusable services, components, and frameworks that promote engineering consistency, scalability, and developer productivity.
  • Apply strong software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, design patterns, automated testing, code reviews, and secure coding standards.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex application and production issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Continuously improve application performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and security.
  • Contribute to cloud-native development, containerization, and CI/CD and DevSecOps practices that enable reliable and efficient software delivery.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence.
  • Participate in Agile planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities while taking ownership of assigned technical outcomes.


All About You

  • Extensive experience as a Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer, or similar role developing enterprise-scale applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and modern Java development practices, with a deep understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, and software design patterns.
  • Proven experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed applications using Spring Boot and the Spring Framework.
  • Experience developing modern, responsive web applications using React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable frontend technologies.
  • Strong experience working with relational databases and SQL, including technologies such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
  • Experience designing and integrating applications using event-driven architectures, messaging platforms such as Kafka, and JSON/XML-based APIs.
  • Experience with cloud-native application development, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Strong understanding of software quality practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, source control, and secure software development.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, analyze system behavior, and optimize application performance and scalability.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through complex projects, platform initiatives, architectural improvements, or cross-team engineering efforts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive solutions from concept through delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM discipline. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong experience with several of the following:
  • Backend: Spring Boot / Spring Framework, REST APIs, Microservices, JPA / Hibernate
  • Frontend: React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 / CSS3
  • Data & Integration: SQL, PostgreSQL / Oracle, Kafka, JSON / XML APIs
  • Cloud, DevOps & Engineering: Azure or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, Automated testing frameworks


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Pay Ranges

O'Fallon, Missouri: $115,000 - $184,000 USD

jobTitle: Software Engineer Full Stack / Backend I (Full Time) - United States
jobDescription:

Applications are accepted until further notice.

Meet the Team

Join a vibrant community of passionate professionals from around the world, working together in Engineering, IT, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, Security & Trust, and more. We are united by a shared mission to make technology accessible and impactful for everyone. In our collaborative environment, you will work with passionate peers on cutting-edge projects where your unique voice and professional growth are top priorities. Join us to learn, innovate, and help shape the future of connection—one idea at a time.

Your Impact

As a Full Stack or Backend Software Engineer at Cisco, you will build the technology that powers global connectivity. Working within inclusive, agile teams, you will design and deliver high-quality features across our cloud-native platforms and microservices. By solving complex challenges and enhancing system scalability, your work will directly impact the reliability of mission-critical systems for our customers. Join us to grow your technical expertise, contribute to real-world innovation, and help build a more connected future.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Bachelor's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate’s, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 1 year of work experience; or
  • High school diploma (or equivalent) with 2 years of work experience.
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Foundational understanding and practical coding proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, Go, C/C++, or JavaScript / TypeScript, with solid knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
  • Understanding of full stack software engineering fundamentals, including RESTful APIs, web development principles (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React), and relational or NoSQL databases.
  • Familiarity with standard software development workflows in Linux environments and Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience or coursework in building modern, responsive user interfaces and single-page applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with a solid grasp of core UI/UX principles.
  • Practical experience in designing and developing scalable distributed backend services, RESTful APIs, or microservices architectures using languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C/C++.
  • Hands-on exposure to containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test automation, cloud security, and networking fundamentals (L2/L3, TCP/IP), combined with a proactive approach to using AI developer tools to enhance productivity and solve complex problems in Agile environments.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Cox Automotive is looking for a senior software engineer that applies the principles of secure software engineering to the design, development, maintenance, testing and evaluation of software and cloud infrastructure. Works cross functionally to understand business requirements, architecture and technology direction, evaluate alternative approaches and ensure software and systems are designed accordingly. Incorporates state-of-the-art concepts and practices to facilitate system functionality, scalability, resilience and security as well as ease-of-use (developer / user experience). Applies agile principles to software development with a focus on delivery of business value, collaboration, continuous improvement and sustainability.

Visa Sponsorship: Cox Automotive is unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 4 years' experience in a related field; or a different combination, such as a master's degree and 2 years' experience; a Ph.D. and 1 years' experience in a related field; or 12 years' experience in a related field with no degree.
  • Professional experience designing, building, and maintaining production software in a modern object-oriented language (e.g., C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, TypeScript, Python, C++).
  • Strong command of object-oriented design fundamentals - encapsulation, composition, interface design, SOLID, dependency injection, and common design patterns - with the judgment to know when not to apply them.
  • Experience delivering software in a microservice or service-oriented architecture, including defining service boundaries, versioning APIs, and handling distributed failure modes (timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure).
  • Experience designing and consuming HTTP/REST APIs (or gRPC/GraphQL equivalents), including contract design, backward compatibility, and authentication/authorization patterns.
  • Proficiency with relational databases: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions, and managed schema migrations.
  • Experience with asynchronous and message-driven processing using queues, topics, or event streams.
  • Experience building and operating services in a public cloud environment, including containerized workloads.
  • Demonstrated automated testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, with work delivered through a CI/CD pipeline.
  • Proficiency with Git-based workflows and code review as a routine part of delivery - both giving and receiving substantive feedback.
  • Experience with production support and observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and triaging live incidents.
  • Track record of senior-level ownership: taking ambiguous problems through design, implementation, and release; decomposing work for others; and raising engineering standards on a team.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in an Agile or iterative delivery model.
  • This role may require participation in a rotating on-call schedule, including support outside of regular business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comfort with AI-assisted development tooling as part of a normal workflow.
  • Hands-on experience with C# and .NET (modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core).
  • Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, including modern component patterns, state management, and component/E2E testing.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL.
  • Experience using Redis for caching, distributed locking, or rate limiting, including cache invalidation strategy.
  • AWS experience, particularly ECS/Fargate, RDS, SQS/SNS, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, and IAM.
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation) and Docker.
  • Familiarity with distributed system patterns such as outbox, saga/compensating transactions, eventual consistency, and idempotent consumers.
  • Demonstrated performance and scalability work: profiling, query optimization, caching strategy, or load testing.
  • Experience with feature flags and progressive delivery (canary releases, dark launches, trunk-based development).
  • Familiarity with static analysis, code quality, and dependency/security scanning tooling (e.g., SonarQube, SAST, SCA).
  • Experience modernizing or retiring legacy systems, including incremental migration approaches such as strangler-fig.
  • Experience integrating third-party vendor APIs, including handling vendor migrations.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience, especially entitlements, tiered packaging, or role-based access control.
  • Domain experience in two-sided marketplaces, logistics, transportation, or automotive.
  • Experience with resiliency practices such as game days, chaos exercises, or documented runbooks.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or interns, and participating in hiring and interview loops.

jobTitle: Software Engineer Full Stack / Backend I (Full Time) - United States
jobDescription:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Applications are accepted until further notice.

Meet the Team

Join a vibrant community of passionate professionals from around the world, working together in Engineering, IT, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, Security & Trust, and more. We are united by a shared mission to make technology accessible and impactful for everyone. In our collaborative environment, you will work with passionate peers on cutting-edge projects where your unique voice and professional growth are top priorities. Join us to learn, innovate, and help shape the future of connection—one idea at a time.

Your Impact

As a Full Stack or Backend Software Engineer at Cisco, you will build the technology that powers global connectivity. Working within inclusive, agile teams, you will design and deliver high-quality features across our cloud-native platforms and microservices. By solving complex challenges and enhancing system scalability, your work will directly impact the reliability of mission-critical systems for our customers. Join us to grow your technical expertise, contribute to real-world innovation, and help build a more connected future.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
  • A Bachelor's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
  • An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate’s, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 1 year of work experience; or
  • High school diploma (or equivalent) with 2 years of work experience.
  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Foundational understanding and practical coding proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, Go, C/C++, or JavaScript / TypeScript, with solid knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
  • Understanding of full stack software engineering fundamentals, including RESTful APIs, web development principles (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React), and relational or NoSQL databases.
  • Familiarity with standard software development workflows in Linux environments and Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience or coursework in building modern, responsive user interfaces and single-page applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with a solid grasp of core UI/UX principles.
  • Practical experience in designing and developing scalable distributed backend services, RESTful APIs, or microservices architectures using languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C/C++.
  • Hands-on exposure to containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test automation, cloud security, and networking fundamentals (L2/L3, TCP/IP), combined with a proactive approach to using AI developer tools to enhance productivity and solve complex problems in Agile environments.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Summary

The Senior Java Software Engineer is responsible for designing, building, modernizing, and supporting reliable enterprise applications and integrations. This role is ideal for an experienced developer with strong Java skills, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, technical team members, and external partners to deliver practical, maintainable solutions.

The Senior Java Software Engineer will report to the IT Delivery Manager and work closely with IT, business stakeholders, and external partners to deliver and support enterprise application solutions. This role is hybrid Chicago (working one day per week from the office). Compensation and benefits will be discussed during the recruiting process and will be based on experience, qualifications, and location.

Key Responsibilities

Software Delivery & Operations

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Java-based enterprise applications and related integrations.
  • Contribute to reliable software delivery through effective use of version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment practices.
  • Support production applications by troubleshooting issues, improving stability, and participating in operational support as needed.
  • Evaluate, refactor, and modernize legacy applications to improve performance, maintainability, scalability, and alignment with current technology standards.

Technical & Business Expertise

  • Develop a strong understanding of application functionality, data models, integrations, and supporting business processes.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into well-designed, maintainable software solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and data pipelines.

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Apply and promote engineering best practices in code quality, testing, release management, documentation, and monitoring.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve application reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and team members to improve system usability, functionality, and alignment with business needs.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, architects, administrators, other developers, and external vendors to clarify requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts, progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to teammates through code reviews, design discussions, troubleshooting, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Java/Jakarta EE software development, including object-oriented design, application architecture, debugging, and maintainable coding practices.
  • Proficient with both JavaScript and SQL for front-end, back-end, or full-stack development, including working knowledge of relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design, application architecture, APIs, databases, integration patterns, data pipelines, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience working in a team-based software delivery environment using source control, testing, deployment practices, and continuous integration/continuous delivery tools.
  • Strong understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
  • Ability to analyze complex problems and deliver practical, maintainable solutions.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly understand complex systems, data models, and technical dependencies.
  • Strong communication skills; able to present technical concepts in business-friendly terms.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments utilizing Scrum or similar methodologies and collaborating with cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience with Open Liberty or similar Java application server platforms.
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Dynamics 365, finance, CRM, or operations-related systems is a plus.
  • Experience with .NET is a plus, or willingness to learn and contribute to .NET-based applications as needed.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-assisted development tools while maintaining strong software engineering discipline, code quality standards, and security practices.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, application engineering, and/or systems integration with a primary focus on Java development.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Pay Range: $ $130,000.-$140,000.

jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer - AI Expereinces, Microsoft Edge
jobDescription:
Overview

Microsoft Edge for Business is building the next generation of secure, AI-powered enterprise browsing. As part of Microsoft’s AI Experiences organization, our team connects the browser with Microsoft’s security, compliance, identity, management, and productivity ecosystem to help organizations confidently adopt AI while protecting their users and data.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to design and deliver security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Copilot integrations for commercial customers. You will work at the intersection of browser technology, enterprise security, and generative AI—building capabilities that protect sensitive information while enabling productive experiences in Microsoft Edge.You will help shape the future of enterprise browser and Copilot management for customers around the world.

This role offers opportunities to drive architecture, influence product direction, mentor engineers, and ship high-quality solutions at Microsoft scale. You will collaborate closely with teams across Microsoft Edge, Microsoft Security, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft AI Experiences. If you enjoy solving complex systems problems, building secure native software, and defining how enterprises securely use AI and business data in the browser, this is an opportunity to make a broad and visible impact.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

AI Experiences employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft Hub in the U.S. are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and ship secure, reliable, and performant features in the Microsoft Edge C++ codebase, with a focus on enterprise security, Data Loss Prevention, and Copilot experiences.
  • Drive technical architecture and execution for integrations between Microsoft Edge and Microsoft’s security, compliance, identity, and management ecosystem, including Microsoft Purview.
  • Lead cross-organizational initiatives spanning browser components, native code, cloud services, and other Microsoft products while applying secure engineering principles to sensitive data, enterprise policies, authentication, and telemetry.
  • Partner with product managers, security experts, and engineers to translate commercial customer requirements into scalable solutions, using telemetry and customer feedback to improve quality, performance, and reliability.
  • Shape the team’s long-term technical strategy, mentor engineers through design and code reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field AND 4+ years of technical engineering experience designing, developing, testing, and debugging production software in C++
    • OR equivalent experience
Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field AND 6+ years of software engineering experience
    • OR a Bachelor’s Degree AND 8+ years of software engineering experience, with substantial production development in C++
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Strong C++ software engineering experience, including designing, implementing, testing, and debugging secure, reliable, and high-performance production software.
  • Strong foundation in modern C++, including object-oriented design, STL, RAII, memory management, multithreading/concurrency, performance optimization, data structures, algorithms, and debugging.
  • Experience with large-scale, cross-platform software systems, ideally involving browsers, operating systems, enterprise security, DLP, identity, or AI-powered product integrations

  • Design and implement core components of the Data Movement Policy (DMP) framework, supporting complex multi-cloud and hybrid environments

  • Own end-to-end delivery of features from design through production deployment


OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with meaningful exposure to infrastructure or security systems

  • Proven ability to design and build distributed systems in Java, Go, or C++

Full-Stack Product Development

jobTitle: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, North Tools & Retrieval
jobDescription:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About North

North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

Why this role?

The Data Abstractions & Tools team is the group inside North responsible for how users bring their data into the platform and put it to work. We own the systems that let users upload, organize, and share their files and knowledge bases, the framework for extending agents with skills and third-party integrations, and the data-sync pipeline that connects enterprise data sources to North's agents.

We are a small team owning a wide surface area, and we need a senior generalist who can move freely across backend and frontend as the roadmap demands. You will pick up any layer of a feature, from API design and database schema to the frontend that sits on top of it, and own it end-to-end.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, ship, and maintain features across the full stack for our roadmap surfaces: large-scale file upload and management, shared knowledge bases, the agent extensibility framework (skills and integrations), and the pipeline that syncs external enterprise data into the platform.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design through implementation, testing, launch, and iteration.
  • Write and ship minimal code that runs in low-resource environments with stringent deployment mechanisms. As security and privacy are paramount, you will sometimes need to re-invent the wheel and won't be able to use the most popular libraries or tooling.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, UX, and the modeling team to validate requirements and prototype quickly.
  • Raise the engineering bar: patterns, testing discipline, code review, and mentoring across the team.
  • Use AI actively in your work, while staying accountable for the quality and reliability of what you ship.

You May Be a Good Fit If

  • Have shipped (lots of) fullstack code (Python and React) in production
  • You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target
  • You have strong coding abilities and are comfortable working across the stack.
  • You have built and deployed extremely performant client-side or server-side RAG/agentic applications to millions of users.
  • You think like a product owner, not just an engineer. You ask "should we build this?" before "how do we build this?"
  • You have strong opinions on what makes a great user experience and aren't afraid to push back on designs or specs that don't serve the user.
  • You've owned features end-to-end: from understanding the user problem, to shipping, to measuring impact.

Working Location:

This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
  • Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How And Where We Work

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Compensation Range: CA$215K - CA$310K

The Team + The Role

The Core team builds features and platform capabilities that power critical areas of the Pendo product experience. The team supports high-stakes customer use cases, shapes how systems evolve over time, and creates a more consistent experience across the platform. This work sits in complex product areas where delivery speed, system reliability, and long-term maintainability all matter.

As a Sr. Software Engineer, you will own complex problem spaces and drive them forward independently. You will apply strong engineering judgment to ambiguous challenges, partner closely with Product and Design, and stay accountable to outcomes, not just output. You will break large efforts into small, continuously shippable increments, bring others along with you, and leave the codebase better than you found it.

This role is based in our Raleigh office.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Feature ownership: Own complex, ambiguous features end-to-end by structuring work into small, independently shippable increments. Drive delivery with clarity, strong judgment, and accountability for customer and system impact.
  • Production engineering: Write production-ready code and define testing approaches based on risk and system impact. Use safe rollout patterns to reduce risk and enable incremental delivery.
  • Incident response: Respond quickly when production issues arise in your area. Resolve issues and drive follow-up improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • AI-enabled development: Use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow for code generation, debugging, test writing, and task decomposition. Help raise the bar for how the team uses AI in development workflows.
  • Technical collaboration: Deliver actionable code reviews, accurate documentation, and constructive contributions to technical discussions and planning sessions. Help teammates make better decisions through clear, direct input.
  • Continuous improvement: Identify recurring friction points in code, tests, tooling, or process and proactively improve them. Look for opportunities to make development faster, safer, and more maintainable.
  • Team clarity: Create context that helps the people around you move faster. Write commit messages, notes, and documentation that allow teammates to understand decisions without relying on verbal handoffs.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with a track record of delivering customer-facing SaaS product features in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to break ambiguous work into small, deliverable increments and move it forward independently despite ambiguity.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages, including Go, Java, Python, or C++.
  • Deep understanding of scalable web architecture, API design, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS or GCP, and both SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience designing and writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, with a clear sense of when and how to apply each.
  • Familiarity with safe deployment and rollout patterns, including feature flags and canary releases.
  • Active use of AI tools as part of your software development workflow.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and cross-functional partnership skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience improving team-level tooling, processes, or developer workflows beyond your immediate feature work.
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up engineers around you through code review or technical documentation.
  • Contributions to shared platform capabilities used across multiple product areas.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Raleigh HQ (301 Hillsborough St.) - Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

Compensation: The expected base salary range for this role to be performed in Raleigh, NC is $135,000 - $150,000.

Benefits: Highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage including $0 premium options, strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for our Payments team — a critical engineering domain responsible for building, scaling, and evolving the payments infrastructure that powers every transaction across the Collectors ecosystem.


This team owns the full lifecycle of payment capabilities: integrating with and abstracting across multiple payment gateway providers (including Stripe and PayPal), supporting payment methods spanning credit card, ACH, and digital wallets, and building both the APIs that downstream services depend on and the web application experiences that customers and internal tools rely on.


As a Staff Software Engineer, your influence extends beyond your team to the technology organization. You have expertise in the entirety of the Payments portfolio — how our services interact and how money and data flow between them — and you are building the same understanding of adjacent systems across grading, marketplace, vault, and identity. 


This is a high-impact, high-visibility role. Payments is the financial backbone of our marketplace — touching grading order checkout, vault and consignment transactions, partner payouts, and customer wallet top-ups. You will own architecture decisions, gateway strategy, and the quality bar for everything that ships.


We believe there is significant value in onsite partnership and team collaboration, and candidates within 1-hour commuting distance of the office may be expected to work onsite most of the time. Additional details will be discussed during the recruiting process.


What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of the Payments domain end to end: Hold expertise across the entirety of the team's products and services — C#/.NET payment services, the distributed event-driven systems they run on in AWS and Kubernetes, their relational and NoSQL data stores, gateway integrations, and the frontends they serve — including how they interact, how data flows between them, and how they fail. Architect for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling through clean service boundaries, contract design, clear data ownership, and well-sequenced migration paths.
  • Set multi-gateway strategy and lead high-stakes migrations: Define the abstractions across payment gateway providers — Stripe, PayPal, and others — so that adding, swapping, or failing over between providers is a low-risk, well-understood operation; own payment flows from initiation through settlement, refund, and reconciliation; and drive gateway migrations, payment-method expansion, and re-platforming efforts with low-risk cutovers under live transaction volume, where correctness of money movement is non-negotiable.
  • Set the bar for security, compliance, and resilience: Establish the standards for PCI-DSS practice, tokenization, idempotency, retry and webhook reliability, audit controls, testing strategy, and observability — then use operational data to drive stability and performance improvements, partnering with Security and Compliance to maintain and advance our certifications.
  • Lead complex, multi-quarter delivery: Lead projects of moderate-to-significant scope spanning 1–2 quarters, coordinating engineers, stakeholders, and dependencies to a predictable landing; plan using an explicit value-vs-cost framework so urgency and prioritization are easily understood by team and stakeholders alike; and surface blockers and delays to the right people before they become surprises.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Translate business requirements into technical solutions and partner across Payments, Marketplace, Grading, Vault, Finance, Security, and platform teams to deliver seamless payment experiences that connect the Collectors ecosystem — building a working model of adjacent systems, including CRM, identity, and data/ETL, that lets you catch cross-system risks early.
  • Multiply the engineers around you: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback; foster a culture of knowledge sharing and documentation within your team and with business stakeholders by initiating and facilitating meaningful discussions around complex issues; and build strong relationships with teammates, your manager, Payments' business and Finance stakeholders, and senior engineers across the organization.
  • Lead an AI-first approach to building: Establish standards and guardrails for AI coding tools — code review expectations, testing requirements, security and IP hygiene — identify where AI agents accelerate payments work, and raise the org's collective AI fluency by sharing proven workflows and coaching engineers on when the tooling helps and when it misleads.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership of multi-engineer, multi-quarter projects. You have a track record of designing, shipping, and scaling products with measurable business impact at a high-growth company or a scaled consumer platform.
  • Expert-level backend engineering in C# (.NET). You own complex API surfaces, async patterns, and data consistency in distributed systems, and you are recognized by peers and leaders as an authority in your domain.
  • Full-stack range. Hands-on production experience across the entire stack — React, Svelte, and TypeScript frontends, API and service layers, data stores, and the infrastructure they run on — with the judgment to design and review at every layer, even where others do the bulk of the implementation.
  • Deep payments or fintech expertise. You have owned gateway integrations, idempotency, webhook reliability, tokenization, reconciliation, and PCI compliance in production, and can reason about failure modes where money is at stake.
  • Deep database and data-modeling expertise, both relational (e.g. PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB). Schema design, migrations, query performance, and the realities of shared-database coupling between services.
  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals. Service boundaries, API and contract design, Kafka-based event-driven architectures, messaging, idempotency, and failure handling — designed and operated in production.
  • Production AWS and Kubernetes depth, with infrastructure-as-code fluency (CDK and/or Terraform).
  • A track record of raising engineering standards across testing strategy, observability, documentation, and incident response.
  • Observability-first mindset. You instrument what you ship using Datadog or similar tools, build dashboards and alerting, and use distributed tracing to debug production issues.
  • Security-minded. You treat payment security as a first-class engineering concern, not an afterthought, and partner with Security and Compliance to maintain and advance our certifications.
  • AI-first engineer. Daily fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar), experience integrating them into team workflows (CI, code review, documentation), and mature judgment about verification, security, and the limits of AI-generated code.
  • Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies. You're comfortable working in iterative delivery cycles, participating in sprint planning, and adapting quickly to changing priorities.
  • Influential communicator. Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and business audiences alike, with sharp analytical and troubleshooting instincts — you align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders without direct authority, make crisp calls, and bring people with you.
  • Bias for ownership. You have an extreme ownership mindset and will wear any hat required to get the job done. You thrive in a fast-moving, self-directed environment — you set the bar, hold it, and take full accountability for outcomes.
  • Passion for collecting is a plus.

Description

Amazon Leo is bringing satellite internet to 100+ countries — and before we can sell in any of them, an enormous amount of behind-the-scenes checking has to pass: is every customer charged correctly, is tax right for that country's laws, does money move to the right accounts, are the invoices legally valid, does the whole buy-and-activate experience actually work end to end? Today, dozens of teams work through this by hand, one step after another, for months. It's the single biggest thing standing between "we're ready" and "we've launched" — and we're replacing that entire process with AI.

Leo Regulus is an AI-native team building squads of autonomous agents that compress Leo's launch process from months to days. The agents run in parallel, share context across every domain a launch touches — tax, accounting, payments, legal, trade, and commerce — and get smarter with each country we ship. Crucially, we don't do the manual work; we build the agents that do it, and do it better each time. Instead of writing the checks by hand, we build agents that write, run, diagnose, and fix them.

This is a rare kind of problem: real autonomy with real stakes — these agents gate a global product launch — and genuine cross-domain reasoning, because a single launch spans law, finance, payments, and the shopping experience all at once, and the agents have to keep each other in sync. You don't need any background in testing or launch operations; you need to be great at building intelligent systems and excited by agentic AI as the product itself — designing how agents plan, act, check their own work, recover from failure, and learn. If building the AI team that launches satellite internet across the planet — in minutes instead of months — sounds like the most interesting thing you could work on, let's talk.

Position Location: Remote in the Contiguous United States - must be able to travel up to 25%

 

 

Job Summary: 

The VMware Cloud Foundation Automation Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, automation, and validation of VMware Cloud Foundation environments, with a strong emphasis on VCF Automation and lifecycle operations. This role is hands on and delivery oriented, supporting greenfield and brownfield deployments, customer integration, and operational enablement across management and workload domains.

  

Essential Functions: 

  • Deploy and configure VMware Cloud Foundation management and workload domains, including a focus on VCF Operations.
  • Design and implement VCF automation workflows to enable repeatable and scalable deployments.
  • Leading technical sessions on innovative data center solutions to improve operational efficiency.
  • Organizing dynamic sales and training sessions on cutting-edge data center technologies.
  • Building strong relationships with Pellera's enterprise solution partners to drive collaboration.
  • Attaining sales and technical certifications to enhance expertise in data center solutions.
  • Staying updated on technical challenges and trends for strategic insights.
  • Supporting clients in their digital transformation with audit, architecture, consulting, implementation, and training.
  • Identifying and validating cloud solution opportunities that integrate with existing systems.
  • Assessing cloud solutions for functionality, service availability, and performance.
  • Evaluating hybrid platform solutions to find the best organizational fit.
  • Ensuring technical feasibility for smooth integration, data exchange, and migration processes.
  • Participate in the development and integration of new and emerging technology solutions and partnerships; with a focus of growing Pellera Technologies.
  • Participate in customer facing meetings to determine business and technical requirements that will be used in developing VMware VCF.
  • Building strong relationships with Pellera's enterprise solution partners to drive collaboration.

 

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies: 

  • VMware skills such as virtualization of servers, storage, and networks; operations management; orchestration and automation; virtual desktop infrastructure and cloud foundation.
  • Subject matter expertise in VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and core data center technologies, with a focus on Automation.
  • Expert-level proficiency in the design and operation of the complete VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) stack, including vSphere, Automation, vSAN, and NSX architectures, as well as working knowledge of other major virtualization platforms.
  • Ability to design and provide architecture on Software Defined Infrastructure.
  • General knowledge of Containers and Native Cloud Services.
  • Ethical and Critical Thinking.
  • Excellent sales and customer service skills, time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines, showing excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong supervisory and leadership skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure automation, scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell), and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients and internal stakeholders. 

 

Education and Experience: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent consulting industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of experience in architecting and implementing data center solutions..
  • Expert-level proficiency in the design and operation of the complete VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) stack, including vSphere, vSAN, and NSX-T architectures, as well as working knowledge of other major virtualization platforms such as Microsoft Hyper-V or KVM layers.
  • Subject matter expertise in VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Automation
  • At least one of the following certifications:  VMware Certified Professional, VCF, VCAP, VCDIX, VMware Knight.
  • Broadcom VMware Knight – highly desired.

 

Physical Requirements:  

  • Candidates should be able to travel up to 25% of the time.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

jobTitle: Full-Stack Software Engineering Intern – MIM Commercialized Web Applications
jobDescription:
Job Description Summary

Join GE HealthCare's MIM Commercialized Web Applications team and help build software that healthcare providers will use every day. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll contribute to cloud and on-prem web applications, work alongside experienced engineers and a dedicated mentor, and gain hands-on experience with modern full-stack technologies while developing software in a regulated healthcare environment.

*Please note this position is an in-office position at our Beachwood, Ohio site.

Job Description

*Please note this position is an in-office position at our Beachwood, Ohio site.

As a Software Engineering Intern at GE Healthcare for our MIM Commercialized Web Applications team, you will contribute to our web applications sold to customers – MIMcloud and MIM Anyware.  

MIMcloud is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) web application which enables secure, HIPAA-compliant cloud-based storage and exchange of medical images between clinical facilities.  

MIM Anyware is an on-premise web application which virtualizes access to our main desktop medical imaging application (MIM) through a web browser. 

What You'll Do: 

  • Contribute full-stack changes to the codebases of MIMcloud and/or MIM Anyware. 

  • Document code, design specifications, and cybersecurity threat models 

  • Test code and write unit tests 

  • Work closely with experienced software engineers, including a personal mentor 

  • Learn about software engineering principles in an industry environment 

  • Learn about engineering best practices for development of regulated medical software 

  • Work on real features with a real-world impact on customers 

Technologies 

MIMcloud 

  • Languages: Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, HTML, SASS/CSS  

  • Frameworks: KTOR, React, JUnit  

  • Database: PostgreSQL  

  • Amazon Web Services: ECS, Lambda, RDS, and S3  

  • Tooling: Git, GitLab, IntelliJ IDEA, Gradle, and Docker Containers 

MIM Anyware 

  • Languages: Java, Scala, TypeScript, HTML, SASS/CSS  

  • Frameworks: Play! Web Framework, React, Bootstrap, jOOQ, Flyway, JUnit 

  • Database: PostgreSQL  

  • Tooling: Git, GitLab, IntelliJ IDEA, sbt, and Docker 

What You'll Need: 

  • Some experience writing code in coursework, projects, or previous internships 

  • An active pursuit of a bachelor's degree, preferably for computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, or physics  

  • General problem-solving skills 

  • Strong analytical thinking 

  • Communication and organization skills 

  • An aptitude for math and science 

  • An existing understanding of medical imaging is not required 

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.



Additional Information

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobTitle: 2027 University Graduate - AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobDescription:
The Opportunity

Adobe's PPCO Transformation Office makes the everyday effortless for employees and managers, and helps our Employee Experience (EX) rise to meet the moments that matter. We're looking for an AI Forward Deployed Engineer to help us move faster. You'll partner directly with teams leading our top transformation initiatives and build AI solutions in weeks, not months.

You'll rotate across the Transformation Office's top initiatives, pairing with an EX process or service leads to turn a real case volume driver or workload bottleneck into a working AI solution, from prototype to production.

You'll also partner with technology teams across Adobe, including product teams, to pilot Adobe's own AI products on Adobe's hardest internal problems as Customer Zero.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with EX process and service leads on the Transformation Office's top initiatives. Turn top priority opportunities into working AI solutions, and build judgment about which problems are worth solving with AI.
  • Design, build, and deploy full stack systems, from frontend to backend to AI integration. Own projects from prototype to production, partnering with tech teams on integrations.
  • Bring reusable patterns and tools back to the Transformation Office so each deployment raises the floor for the next team.
  • Present findings, demos, and recommendations directly to collaborators and leadership. Build trust as a technical owner, not just a contributor.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Data Science, Human Computer Interaction, Information Science, AI, or a related field. Expected graduation between December 2026 and June 2027.
  • Demonstrated experience building full stack software (frontend and backend) through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
  • Hands on experience with generative AI tools and APIs (such as Claude, GPT, or Copilot), and comfort designing prompts, workflows, or lightweight agents.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and/or JavaScript, including API integration and version control.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical collaborators, and vice versa.

jobTitle: CVP Software Infrastructure and Forward Deployed Engineering
jobDescription:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

Own the two capabilities that most directly determine how fast and how well AIG's software organization ships: (1) the engineering infrastructure and developer productivity layer that AIG's software teams run on, and (2) the Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) function that puts AMD software into customers' and partners' hands and converts field learnings back into the roadmap.

THE PERSON:

Define and institutionalize the Software Infrastructure and FDE Engagement to maximize resource leverage and ensure consistent, high-velocity customer outcomes. Serve as the Voice of the Customer internally: Translate field intelligence and customer challenges into concrete, prioritized engineering roadmaps, and ensure execution. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Software Infrastructure & Developer Productivity

Own developer productivity, engineering velocity, and the internal developer platform for AIG's software organization — the tooling, CI/CD, and workflows engineers use every day.

Manage developer workloads and productivity against GPU capacity, integrating CI/CD, test, and utilization for these engineering workflows directly into the engineering organization.

Operate on a clear division of responsibility with IT: IT provides and manages the standardized base infrastructure and the underlying SLAs; engineering owns the developer-facing workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and utilization/efficiency of that capacity — with the intent that these engineering-integrated workflows are increasingly managed by engineering over time.

Establish honest, non-punitive productivity and utilization metrics that drive real efficiency gains in how AIG consumes GPU and compute capacity.

  1. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)

Build and lead the FDE function for AIG's software organization — engineers deployed alongside key customers and partners to deploy, integrate, and optimize AMD software (ROCm and the broader AI stack) in real workloads.

Close the loop between the field and the core engineering roadmap: translate deployment friction, performance gaps, and customer requirements into prioritized engineering work.

Serve as a scaling mechanism for adoption — turning individual high-touch engagements into repeatable patterns, reference architectures, and tooling that reduce the cost of the next deployment.

 

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Years of Technical Leadership: Demonstrated track record leading high-impact technical teams within high-stakes environments (e.g., Cloud Infrastructure, AI Platform, or HPC). 
  • The "Hardware/Software" Hybrid: You understand the stack from the metal up. 
  • Commercial Acumen & Fluency: Deep understanding of commercial drivers (ARR, Churn, Margin) and the ability to articulate how technical solutions impact deal velocity and business outcomes. 
  • High-Stakes Crisis Management: Experience leading through "Sev0" customer incidents (e.g., massive training run failures), demonstrating the poise and clarity required to manage executive communication while guiding rapid root cause resolution. 

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • BS, MS or equivalent with direct experience
