Purpose:


The Sr. Manager, eCommerce Technology, leads the eCommerce Engineers responsible for building and delivering Floor and Decor's digital systems. This role owns the day-to-day leadership of the eCommerce engineering organization — translating the Sr. Director’s technology strategy into staffed, well-run engineering pods that consistently deliver on roadmap commitments.


The Sr. Manager partners closely with the Sr. Director, eCommerce Technology and the eCommerce Architect to align staffing, delivery plans, and technical direction, while building a high-performing, full-stack engineering organization grounded in React, Java, and large-scale commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud or WebSphere Commerce. This leader also champions modern engineering practices — including the responsible use of AI-assisted (“vibe coding”) development tools — to raise team velocity and quality across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications


  • 8-12 years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years directly managing engineering leads or senior engineers
  • Experience leading multiple engineering teams or pods simultaneously, ideally within an eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital environment
  • Strong full-stack technical background across React and Java, sufficient to evaluate technical trade-offs and support engineering leads in technical decision-making
  • Demonstrated experience with large-scale eCommerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WebSphere Commerce, or a comparable enterprise platform
  • Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering talent

Preferred


  • Experience scaling an eCommerce or digital commerce engineering organization through growth or modernization initiatives
  • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, and vendor/contractor relationships for an engineering organization
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale (e.g., SAFe) and experience running program management practices across multiple teams
  • Practical experience championing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) across an engineering organization
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Talent magnet – Known for attracting, developing, and retaining strong engineers; people want to work for you.
  • Executive communication – Able to translate technical complexity into clear, business-relevant updates for senior leadership.
  • Bias for delivery – Keeps teams focused on outcomes, unblocking work quickly and holding a high bar for quality without slowing the team down.
  • Global Perspective
  • Manages Ambiguity
  • Nimble Learning
  • Self-Development
  • Collaborates
  • Cultivate Innovation
  • Situational Adaptability
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Drives Results
  • Interpersonal Savvy

Essential Functions / Key Responsibilities:


Org & People Leadership

  • Directly manage eCommerce Engineers, providing coaching, performance management, and career development
  • Own workforce planning for the eCommerce engineering organization, partnering with Talent Acquisition to hire and scale teams in line with business growth
  • Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across engineering pods

Delivery & Program Execution

  • Own end-to-end delivery execution across multiple engineering pods, ensuring roadmap commitments are met on time and within budget
  • Establish and mature program management practices, including capacity planning, dependency management, and risk mitigation across teams
  • Serve as an escalation point for cross-team delivery risks, resourcing conflicts, and significant production issues

Technical & Architectural Alignment

  • Partner with the eCommerce Architect to ensure engineering pods execute against approved architecture, technical standards, and platform roadmaps
  • Maintain enough hands-on technical fluency across React, Java, and the core commerce platform (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WebSphere Commerce) to evaluate trade-offs and support Lead Engineers in technical decision-making
  • Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices and other modern engineering tooling across the organization

Budget & Vendor Management

  • Own budget stewardship for the eCommerce engineering organization, including staffing, tooling, and vendor/contractor spend
  • Manage relationships with staffing partners, contractors, and technology vendors supporting the eCommerce engineering team
  • Track and report on team capacity, spend, and delivery metrics to the Sr. Director, eCommerce Technology

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, Design, QA, and Program Management leadership to align engineering capacity with roadmap priorities
  • Communicate delivery status, risks, and organizational health clearly to the Sr. Director, eCommerce Technology and other senior stakeholders

We're looking for a Senior Software Architect to own how our systems are designed, modernized, and built. This is a senior technical leadership role, not a senior coding role. You'll collaborate with architect peers on the direction for the technology, and you'll still be in the code. You'll be handed existing systems, requirements for systems that don’t exist yet, and asked what they should become, and trusted to chart a route that's actually walkable - with peers, contract engineers and AI coding agents doing much of the walking alongside you.

What you'll do

  • Architect end-to-end. Design flows and system boundaries across the full stack - data model, services, APIs, front end, integrations - and own the decisions that are expensive to reverse.
  • Read existing systems and plan their future. Take apart a working system, find where the real complexity and risk live, and produce a migration roadmap to a new platform or architecture that is sequenced, incremental, and something a team can execute without a long term freeze.
  • Balance the real constraints. Every architecture is a trade among speed to market, maintainability, performance, security, scalability, and cost. You'll make those trades deliberately, write down why, and revisit them when the business changes.
  • Build, not just diagram. Stay in the code. Prototype the risky part first. Set the patterns the rest of the team follows by writing them.
  • Lead contract resources. Scope work, set technical direction and standards, review output, and keep distributed or contract engineers productive and aligned - without becoming the bottleneck.
  • Translate. Explain options, risks, and costs to non-technical stakeholders in plain language, so the business can make an informed call rather than defer to whoever sounds most certain.
  • Work AI-natively. Use coding agents as a primary tool for delivery, and set the standards for how the rest of the team does the same.

Desired skills and experience:

Engineering depth

  • Extensive full-stack experience - comfortable owning back end, front end, data, and infrastructure concerns
  • Genuine polyglot instincts: you pick up new languages, frameworks, and platforms because the problem calls for it, not because you were assigned a training course
  • Cloud, CI/CD, and production-operations literacy - you've supported what you've shipped

Architecture & modernization

  • A track record of system design work you can walk us through: what you chose, what you rejected, what broke, what you'd do differently
  • Legacy assessment and modernization experience - strangler-fig patterns, incremental decomposition, data migration, dual-run and cutover strategies
  • Security, compliance, and scalability treated as design inputs, not a hardening pass at the end

AI-native practice

  • Expert, daily user of AI coding agents - Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Aider, Devin, or equivalents — and opinionated about where each one earns its keep
  • Fluent in the concepts that separate good agent use from slot-machine prompting: context engineering and context-window management, prompt engineering, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, skills, subagents and agentic loops, tool use, RAG, evals, spec-driven development, and sandboxing/guardrails
  • Disciplined about reviewing agent output - you know that generated code you haven't understood is a liability, and you build the review and testing practices that keep it from becoming one
  • Able to set team-level standards for AI-assisted development: what gets delegated, what gets human eyes, how quality is verified

Leadership & communication

  • Experience directing contract, offshore, or vendor engineering resources to a real outcome
  • Comfortable shifting direction when priorities move - you treat a changed plan as new information, not as wasted work
  • You can hold a conversation with a stakeholder who doesn't care about the architecture, and leave them understanding their choices
  • Strong written communication: design docs, ADRs, roadmaps that people actually read

Nice to have

  • Modern front-end depth (React, TypeScript, or equivalent)
  • Experience with .NET/C#, Nodejs, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL
  • Amazon Web Services
  • OIDC/OAuth2 authentication concepts
  • Event-driven, message queueing or distributed-systems experience
  • Having built internal tooling, MCP servers, or agent workflows for a team
  • Mentorship or technical-leadership history with junior and mid-level engineers

  • Define and own the full-stack architecture (frontend, backend, APIs, data layer) for the agentic AI platform's UI and supporting services
  • Establish design patterns for building responsive, real-time interfaces that visualize agent reasoning, multi-step task execution, tool calls, and streaming outputs
  • Drive decisions on frameworks, state management, API contracts (REST/GraphQL/WebSockets/streaming), and infrastructure choices in partnership with platform/infra teams
  • Ensure the architecture supports scalability, low-latency streaming (token-by-token or event-based UI updates), extensibility for new agent capabilities, and enterprise-grade security
  • Build, lead, and grow a team of full-stack engineers, frontend specialists, and backend engineers (potentially across multiple pods/squads)
  • Set engineering standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, accessibility, and performance
  • Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers; support career development and technical growth across the org
  • Drive a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and rapid iteration appropriate to a fast-evolving AI product space
  • Partner with Product Management and Design to translate agentic AI capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, memory, planning) into intuitive, trustworthy user experiences
  • Work closely with AI/ML and Platform Engineering teams to expose model/agent behavior (reasoning traces, confidence, citations, errors) in ways that build user trust and transparency
  • Collaborate with UX research to iterate on interaction patterns unique to agentic systems (e.g., approvals, interruptions, plan editing, multi-turn context)
  • Own roadmap planning, sprint execution, and delivery predictability for the UI/full-stack workstream
  • Establish metrics for platform reliability, performance (latency, load times, streaming responsiveness), and UI quality
  • Manage technical risk, tech debt, and platform scalability trade-offs as the product scales to more users, agents, and use cases
  • Report progress, risks, and technical strategy to senior leadership/executives


You’ll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.


Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership 
  • Solid hands-on expertise across the modern full-stack: Frontend: React/Next.js (or similar), TypeScript, state management, real-time/streaming UI patterns (WebSockets, SSE), component design systems. Backend: Node.js, Python, Go, or Java; API design (REST/GraphQL); microservices architecture
  • Experience building or integrating with LLM/AI-powered products - e.g., chat interfaces, copilots, agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-calling architectures
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping complex, production-grade web applications at scale (consumer or enterprise SaaS)
  • Direct experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, custom orchestration) 
  • Infrastructure: Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines


Preferred Qualifications:

  • MS/BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience at an AI-native company or on an AI platform/tooling team
  • Experience with design systems and accessibility standards (WCAG) for enterprise software
  • Experience with streaming data visualization (e.g., visualizing multi-step agent plans, tool call graphs, live logs)
  • Familiarity with agent observability concepts - tracing, evals, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review flows
  • Background in developer tools, low-code/no-code builders, or workflow orchestration UIs
  • Exposure to security/compliance considerations for enterprise AI products (SOC 2, data governance, PII handling)
  • Proven excellent communication skills; ability to operate across technical depth and executive-level strategy conversations

No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you’ll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. Job Details
Job: Software Engineering
Primary Location: US-MN-Minnetonka
Organization: UHC Operations and Experience
Schedule: Full-time
Number of Openings: 1

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will make an impact by designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications using Java technologies and modern backend frameworks. You will be a valued member of the application development team and work collaboratively with architects, business analysts, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality enterprise solutions.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using Java 7/8, Spring Framework, and Spring Boot.
  • Lead the development and implementation of application components, microservices, REST APIs, and backend services following established SDLC practices.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical designs, specifications, and development activities.
  • Develop high-quality, reusable, and maintainable code utilizing coding standards, design patterns, and industry best practices.
  • Leverage Java 8 functional programming capabilities, including Lambda expressions, Streams API, and Optional classes, to enhance application performance and code quality.
  • Collaborate with architects, business analysts, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions.
  • Perform code reviews, provide technical guidance, and mentor junior developers.
  • Participate in performance tuning, troubleshooting, debugging, and production support activities.
  • Ensure application security, reliability, scalability, and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Support automated build and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.

Work Model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on business and client requirements.

What You Need to Have to Be Considered

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java 7/8 development.
  • Experience developing applications using Spring Framework and Spring Boot.
  • Proven experience building REST APIs, microservices, and backend services.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and application design principles.
  • Experience utilizing Java 8 functional programming features, including Lambda expressions, Streams API, and Optional classes.
  • Knowledge of code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and application performance tuning.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.
  • Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional team environments.

These Will Help You Stand Out

  • Experience leading development teams and providing technical mentorship.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture and design patterns.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable applications.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Applications will be accepted until: 9/30/2026
Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary and Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $54,000pa - $71,000pa depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Full-Stack Engineer

Location: Remote, United States (Austin, TX preferred)

Job Type: Full-time, W-2

Pay: $125,000-$150,000 per year

Architect and build the application platform that helps children with disabilities thrive in school.

About Thrive Therapies Group

Thrive Therapies Group is a pediatric healthcare company focused on making schools more equitable and inclusive for students with disabilities. Our mission is to be the best pediatric healthcare company in the country for children with disabilities. Getting there means more than great providers; it means building the technology and systems that let our speech-language pathologists, occupational therapists, physical therapists and school psychologists do their best work, and creating clinical intelligence that improves care for under-resourced learners everywhere.

About the Role

Thrive Therapies Group is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer on our platform team, reporting to our Chief Product and Technology Officer. You will own the architecture of our core applications, build features end to end, and set the quality bar for our team (including offshore). This role is ideal for an engineer with 4 to 7 years of experience who is curious, loves to tinker, and wants to build something meaningful from the ground up.

Our platform is a multi-tenant system on AWS: Python, FastAPI services on ECS Fargate, React and TypeScript front end, Aurora PostgreSQL, event-driven ingestion through S3, EventBridge and SQS, infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, and AI capabilities through Amazon Bedrock and Claude. It supports our care workflows, billing and reimbursement, insights on student outcomes, and more.

What You'll Do

Architect and Build

  • Own the architecture of the core application platform, including service boundaries, the data model, and the layering of routes, services, repositories and models

  • Build features end to end across FastAPI APIs, React and TypeScript interfaces, and PostgreSQL schemas with reversible migrations

  • Design event-driven pipelines that ingest care documents, session audio/video, demographics, and billing files.

  • Integrate AI services into clinical documentation and insights workflows

  • Evolve our AWS infrastructure as code with CDK

Set the Quality Bar

  • Lead design reviews for high-risk changes such as core platform scalability and security, workflow logic, bulk operations and data model changes

  • Review pull requests from our team for tenant isolation, authorization, PHI handling and database safety

  • Own AI tool governance, deciding which models and tools may touch our code and data, for our team and our partners

  • Maintain CI gates, automated tests and observability across Sentry, OpenTelemetry and CloudWatch

Stay Close to the Work

  • Spend time with providers, leaders, and operations teams to understand workflows before automating them

  • Own the adoption of what you ship, not only the release

Grow the Team

  • Serve as the day-to-day technical guide for a Full-Stack Engineer Intern

  • Document decisions and establish engineering practices as the team grows

How We Work

  • AI-native by default. We plan, build, test, review and submit with AI tools in the loop, and we expect you to reach for them without being asked.

  • Weekly operating cadence. We plan on Monday, build continuously through the week, and release when the work is ready and tested.

  • Forward-deployed. The people who build a tool also own its adoption. We sit with providers and operations teams, feel the manual pain first, then automate it.

  • Plan, do, check, act. We write down what we intend, build it, measure whether it worked, and adjust.

Qualifications

  • 4 to 7 years of professional experience building production web applications and integrations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field

  • Strong Python, ideally FastAPI or a similar framework, and React with TypeScript

  • Relational data modeling in PostgreSQL, including safe migrations on live tables

  • Hands-on AWS experience with containers, managed databases, IAM and infrastructure as code (CDK, Terraform or CloudFormation)

  • Daily use of AI-assisted development, including agentic coding tools and AI code review, with the judgment to catch when AI output is wrong

  • Experience with sensitive or regulated data, including multi-tenant isolation, role-based access and keeping sensitive data out of logs

  • Clear written communication and comfort working with distributed and offshore teams

  • Ability to complete HIPAA training and pass a background check

Preferred Experience

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field

  • Healthcare technology experience and working knowledge of HIPAA

  • Healthcare billing or clearinghouse integrations

  • LLM or speech-to-text features running in production

  • Data engineering, including pipelines and analytics models

  • Startup or zero-to-one product experience

Why Join Thrive Therapies Group

Build From the Ground Up

Very few engineers get to help design something from zero. You will shape the architecture, the practices and the team.

Meaningful Impact

What you build helps providers spend more time with children and gives schools and families better insight into outcomes.

An AI-Native Team

Work with current AI development tools every day, alongside leaders who expect you to use them well.

Benefits

Full benefits, competitive equity, and 401(k) match

Apply Today

If you are an engineer who wants to own the architecture of an application platform that improves care for children with disabilities, we encourage you to apply.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to own and deliver end-to-end software solutions for our Sales organization's AI-powered applications. You'll take ownership of the UI, workflow, integrations, and data layer across an existing portfolio of AI tools — driving architectural decisions, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating with our AI team, Business Solutions Lead, and product owners — while our AI team continues to own the underlying algorithm and model components.  What You Will Do:

  • Own the software layers of our AI-powered Sales applications — UI, workflow, integrations, and data validation — while our AI team owns the underlying algorithm and model components. 
  • Take over support and enhancement of the existing AI application portfolio, progressively reducing dependence on the AI team.

  • Working familiarity with DevOps and QE (quality engineering) concepts — CI/CD, containerized deployment, and automated testing — and comfort building cloud-based production systems (Azure primarily) within an existing shared platform. 
  • Experience with SQL, data modeling, and designing for performance and reliability. 
  • Fluent daily use of AI-assisted development tools, including agentic workflows and CLI's such Claude Code or Codex 
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across cross-functional teams. 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and drive results in a fast-paced environment. 

Preferred Experiences: 

  • Experience integrating with or extending generative AI / ML services and agentic architectures. 
  • Experience with prompt engineering and developing or maintaining reusable AI skills, prompt libraries, or tool definitions for agentic systems. 
  • Dynamics 365 / CRM integration experience. 
  • Experience with testing automation, release management, and support/on-call practices. 
  • Background in sales or quoting workflows. 
  • Must be able to clearly and concisely communicate technical perspective and status to ensure shared understanding both upwards and downwards in the organization. 
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, agile environment while providing consistent application lifecycle management.

SIEM Engineering & Insider Risk Analytics SME 

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of SIEM Engineering & Insider Risk Analytics SME to join our cybersecurity and insider risk team. This role is in Houston, TX.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SIEM engineering, cybersecurity operations, data analytics, and User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA), with experience working across multiple risk domains. They will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate monitoring technologies, improve threat visibility, identify High-Risk Users, develop and tune use cases, protect crown jewel assets, strengthen operational processes, and prioritize risk through a combination of user inherent risk and observed user behavior.

Key Responsibilities 

 SIEM Engineering & Platform Management: 

  • Design, stand up, configure, deploy, maintain, and support enterprise SIEM platforms for security monitoring, insider risk detection, and threat response. 
  • Develop and fine-tune correlation rules, use cases, UEBA models, and behavioral analytics to identify High-Risk Users and detect insider risk, fraud, and advanced cyber threats, prioritizing risk through user inherent risk, observed behavior, and potential exposure to crown jewel assets. 
  • Assist in the management of log ingestion pipelines and optimize data collection from network, endpoint, cloud, identity, workstation monitoring, and other security data sources. 
  • Deploy, support, and troubleshoot User Enhanced Monitoring workstations and related platform integrations, performance, and data-processing pipelines. 

Data Analytics & Threat Intelligence:

•  Develop data models, analytics dashboards, reports, and risk-scoring approaches that enhance security monitoring, forensic investigations, and user risk prioritization. 

•  Apply AI, machine learning, statistical analysis, and behavioral analytics to detect anomalies, identify emerging patterns, and improve insider risk detection. 

•  Integrate SIEM, threat intelligence, endpoint, identity, case management, and other security applications into a unified insider risk program. 

•  Conduct trend and threat analysis across multiple risk domains and a broad range of cyber and insider risk scenarios to support High-Risk User identification, crown jewel protection, proactive risk mitigation, early detection, and rapid response. 

Incident Detection & Response Support:

•  Collaborate with Insider Threat analysts, threat hunters, fraud teams, and other security partners to investigate incidents using SIEM, UEBA, endpoint, identity, and workstation monitoring data. 

•  Maintain and enhance insider risk workflows through use case development, alert tuning, automation, process improvements, and response orchestration that reduce time to detection and response. 

•  Assist in root cause analysis and remediation efforts for complex security threats. 

Compliance & Optimization:

•  Ensure SIEM configurations align with regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI DSS).

•  Maintain documentation for use cases, data flows, integrations, operating procedures, risk-scoring logic, and SIEM policies across the unified insider risk program. 

•  Identify and implement improvements to log ingestion, data normalization, system scalability, analytic coverage, operational processes, and program effectiveness. 

•  Provide peer review of use cases and threat models to ensure efficacy and effectiveness. 

Qualifications & Experience

•  Experience in SIEM engineering, cybersecurity operations, or data analytics. 

10-12 years of experience in information security or related technology experience required, experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus

•  Strong hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM platforms, including platform implementation and support, rule and use case development, log ingestion, integrations, and dashboard development. 

•  Proficiency in SQL, Python, Splunk, Elastic Stack, or other data analytics tools. 

•  Experience with threat detection, UEBA development, AI and machine learning in security, and risk prioritization using both user inherent risk and user behavior. 

•  Familiarity with cloud security monitoring (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integration with SIEM solutions. 

•  Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, insider risk and fraud detection, user and entity behavior analytics, crown jewel protection, and a broad range of cyber threats, attack patterns, adversary techniques, and risk domains. 

•  Strong understanding of log management, data correlation, and incident response frameworks. 

•  Certifications such as SANS GIAC, CISSP, CEH, or relevant SIEM, analytics, cloud, or AI certifications are a plus. 

Preferred Skills:

•  Experience working in the financial sector with a focus on fraud prevention, insider risk, or compliance monitoring. 

•  Knowledge of big data platforms (Hadoop, Spark, Snowflake), automation tools (SOAR, Python scripting, APIs), and integration patterns for connecting security applications across an insider risk ecosystem. 

•  Experience applying analytics across multiple risk domains to identify High-Risk Users, assess access and behavioral risk, and protect crown jewel assets and other critical resources. 

•  Experience deploying and supporting User Enhanced Monitoring workstations, working with large datasets, and building predictive or AI-assisted models for actionable security insights.

jobDescription:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!  

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

Blue Origin's Lunar RF Systems group is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer. In this role you will work with a hard-working team of RF hardware, antenna, DSP, and FPGA engineers developing communications components for our Lunar Vehicles. Built with modern Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA), microcontrollers, and advanced System-on-Chip (SoC) devices, our products host embedded software that configures, controls, performs preprocessing, and enhances the operation of our hardware components.

We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer that will be responsible for designing, implementing and verifying embedded software for mission-critical spaceflight systems working directly with our hardware engineers. This is a software role that is hardware heavy, and the candidate that we are looking for should be comfortable reading hardware datasheets, understanding registers maps, have a keen sense of performance tradeoffs, and must have hands-on lab debugging skills. You will collaborate with cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams and often work on multiple embedded software efforts simultaneously.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!


Responsibilities Include but are not limited to:

  • Developing Board Support Package (BSP) software for new hardware, including driver development
  • Bare-metal or OS-level programming for hardware initialization, control, embedded data processing, and networking/communication
  • Hands-on work with avionics spaceflight hardware, including debugging with logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and JTAG debuggers
  • Participating in design concepts and reviews, with special attention to partitioning between HW and SW implementation
  • Performing benchmark analysis and deploying benchmarking code to characterize hardware performance
  • Bring up and utilization of HW-accelerators in modern SoC devices (e.g. encoders, decoders, encryption engines, image signal processing cores, etc.)
  • Scripting, Linux development, and hands-on work with development kits and sensor modules
  • Defining and implementing embedded SW for interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, TCP/IP, UDP, GMSL, SpaceWire, CameraLink, Aurora, AXI, AMBA, etc.
  • Developing boot and SW-based fault-tolerance strategies
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and procedures that cover all functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Execute test procedures in a laboratory setting to verify that boards meet all specified requirements and perform root-cause analysis on discrepancies.
  • Publishing internal documents and memos, participating in design reviews, reviewing and generating requirements
  • Willingness to learn new skills, languages, debug/development tools

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of experience in the field(s) above
  • Experience developing board support packages and applications for embedded Linux targets.
  • Strong embedded software design and development skills in C/C++ with Linux (or similar) scripting experience
  • Strong debugging skills, using a mix of cross HW/SW techniques and tools (GDB, XSDB, GRMON, Logic Analyzer, Protocol Analyzer, Wireshark, etc.), and experience single stepping through code, looking at Assembly, probing memory, and driving I/O
  • Strong background in computer architecture, understanding of memory buses, cache, DMA, CPU execution pipelines
  • Experience with version control systems (Git)
  • Ability to work well in a team and independently with minimal direction

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Possessing a Master of Science in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field
  • Extensive experience in prototype development, debug, and test in a lab environment. Experience testing RF hardware is a plus.
  • Previous experience building space software systems
  • Experience with DO-178C, NASA NPR 7150.2D and companion document certification guidelines
  • Experience with FPGA development (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog)
  • Experience with software for HW-accelerated functions (encryption/decryption blocks, encoder/decoder blocks, GPU, etc.)
  • Experience with tools and software for data analysis and post processing (Matlab, Python, open-source Linux tool)
  • Experience with agile development methods
  • Experience with kernel and driver development

Special Mentions:

  • Relocation provided
  • Blue Origin has multiple locations. Depending on the location chosen for this opportunity, you may be expected to travel up to 20% to support hardware deliveries, meetings, and reviews

Blue Origin’s Lunar RF Systems group is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Verification & Test Engineer to support communications components for our lunar vehicles. In this role you will work with a hard-working team of RF hardware, antenna, DSP, and FPGA engineers.

Our products use FPGAs, microcontrollers, and advanced system-on-chip devices to configure and control RF hardware, perform signal preprocessing, manage communications interfaces, and monitor system health. In this role, you will define and execute the verification strategy for embedded software operating on flight RF hardware, from early development through qualification, acceptance, vehicle integration, and flight support.

You will combine requirements-based verification, test automation, hands-on laboratory debugging, and cross-functional technical leadership to help deliver reliable systems for safe human spaceflight.

Responsibilities Include but are not limited to:

  • Develop and maintain software verification strategies, test plans, procedures, and requirements traceability matrix for spaceflight RF components.
  • Derive electrical test requirements from system specifications, ICD’s, schematics, and safety requirements.
  • Review system, software, interface, and safety requirements for clarity, completeness, and testability.
  • Develop automated test frameworks, scripts, test firmware, equipment-control software, and data-analysis tools.
  • Perform software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, bench-level, and integrated RF testing.
  • Verify functional, performance, timing, interface, startup, fault-management, and recovery requirements.
  • Establish objective pass/fail criteria and maintain configuration-controlled test procedures, software, equipment configurations, and results.
  • Debug embedded systems using laboratory equipment and software-debug tools.
  • Lead anomaly investigations across software, FPGA logic, digital hardware, and RF hardware; drive corrective actions through closure.
  • Participate in requirements, design, test-readiness, qualification, and acceptance reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in embedded software in embedded software verification, integration, test, or development.
  • Experience converting requirements into traceable test cases, procedures, and objective pass/fail criteria.
  • Strong embedded C or C++ development and debugging skills.
  • Proficiency with Python or similar languages for test automation, equipment control, and data analysis.
  • Experience testing embedded software on microcontroller, FPGA, or SoC based hardware.
  • Hands-on experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing and laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic or protocol analyzers, power supplies, multimeters, and signal generators.
  • Experience debugging across hardware and software using tools such as GDB, JTAG debuggers, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and Wireshark.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis and clearly document test results and anomalies.
  • Experience with Git or another modern version-control system and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong technical communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Possessing a Master of Science in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience developing or verifying flight software, spacecraft avionics, RF communications systems, or other safety-critical embedded systems.
  • Experience applying formal software assurance and configuration-management practices, including DO-178C or comparable aerospace standards.
  • Experience with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators/analyzers, power meters, and attenuators.
  • Experience with automated regression frameworks and continuous integration.
  • Experience with fault injection, robustness testing, performance characterization, and off-nominal testing.
  • Familiarity with embedded interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, SpaceWire, Aurora, AXI, or AMBA.

  • Experience with qualification, acceptance, environmental, or EMI/EMC test campaigns.

  • Experience with technical leadership and mentoring.

About the Role  

The Smart Collect team builds the platform that determines what vehicle data to collect, validates collection configurations, deploys them across fleets, and monitors the resulting data from vehicle to cloud. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to develop the services, integrations, automation, and end-to-end observability that power this platform. Scaling high-quality data collection is essential to enabling autonomous and eyes-off driving. Your work will ensure that data flows reliably from vehicles into our AI/ML and analytics platforms, with strong guarantees around quality, traceability, privacy, and operational excellence. You will collaborate with AI research, data engineering, vehicle engineering, data science, product, data quality, and operations teams to deliver dependable services and intuitive tools that scale across General Motors programs.

What You’ll Do  

  • Design and develop APIs, domain services, event-driven workflows, and vehicle-recording metadata pipelines.

  • Build services and user experiences for defining collection events and triggers, selecting data, generating and validating configurations, deploying campaigns, and monitoring results.

  • Design version-aware workflows that reconcile signals, schemas, hardware capabilities, and software compatibility across vehicle platforms.

  • Improve visibility into campaign health, fleet coverage, recording volume, ingestion latency, and data quality.

  • Lead technical design and deliver cross-team initiatives involving vehicle recording, fleet management, data platforms, autonomy, privacy, product, and program teams.

  • Raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, automated testing, code reviews, technical mentorship, and production support.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)  

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proficiency in Python or another modern backend programming language.

  • Strong experience designing scalable backend services, APIs, and relational data models.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, data ingestion, testing, debugging, and production operations.

  • Ability to communicate technical decisions and lead work across organizational boundaries.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)  

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Google Cloud (including BigQuery and Pub/Sub), Kafka, observability platforms, or data-quality systems.

  • Experience with FastAPI, React, or TypeScript.

  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, automotive software, embedded systems, or other safety-critical domains.

  • Familiarity with sensor data, vehicle data collection, fleet management, deployment control planes, or software-version compatibility.

  • Experience addressing privacy, data governance, resource constraints, or multi-environment deployments.

jobDescription:
Description

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and optimize the Mobile Backend for Frontend (MBFF) platform and back-office integration services that power GM mobile ownership experiences. This role will focus on building secure, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java and Spring Boot, while advancing modern engineering practices across API development, cloud-native operations, DevOps automation, and observability.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth in microservices, hands-on cloud engineering experience in Azure, and a practical understanding of how AI-enabled tools can improve engineering productivity and operational insight. This engineer will play a key role in delivering platform capabilities that improve reliability, accelerate delivery, and simplify how mobile applications integrate with GM enterprise systems.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices, REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and event-driven integrations using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Build secure, reliable, and performant backend services that support mobile application experiences and enterprise workflows.

  • Deploy and operate services on Azure using AKS, API Management, Functions, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, and related cloud-native services.

  • Strengthen DevOps practices by building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, environment consistency, and release governance using Azure DevOps and Git-based workflows.

  • Improve system observability through metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and service health monitoring using tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Azure Monitor.

  • Define, monitor, and continuously improve service reliability through meaningful SLOs, SLAs, and operational health indicators aligned to customer and business expectations.

  • Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, operational insight, anomaly detection, incident triage, and capacity awareness.

  • Use Test-Driven Development (TDD) and strong engineering fundamentals to deliver maintainable, well-tested software with robust unit, integration, and functional test coverage.

  • Partner with product, architecture, security, and dependent engineering teams to deliver solutions aligned to business and customer needs.

  • Mentor engineers on microservices design, API standards, testing strategy, observability, and DevOps best practices.

  • Contribute to architecture documentation, operational runbooks, API documentation, and engineering standards across the team.

Additional Job Description

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including strong hands-on development in Java and Spring Boot.

  • Proven experience designing and building microservices and RESTful APIs in distributed systems.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, including containerized deployments and managed services.

  • Strong understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-aware development, and automated deployment practices.

  • Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), automated testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito, and modern software engineering best practices.

  • Strong experience with SQL databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively across teams.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with GraphQL, WebSockets, and event-driven or asynchronous architecture patterns.

  • Experience with NoSQL technologies such as Cosmos DB or Cassandra.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services such as AKS, API Management, Functions, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.

  • Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.

  • Experience with observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, OpenTelemetry, or similar monitoring platforms.

  • Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, release automation, and production support in cloud-native environments.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and applying AI-driven operational capabilities for log analysis, incident response, anomaly detection, or engineering productivity.

  • Knowledge of security best practices including OAuth2, JWT, secrets management, and API gateway patterns.

  • Familiarity with mobile backend workflows, enterprise integration patterns, and ownership experiences platforms.

  • Experience working in Agile product teams and mentoring engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and delivery execution.

Job Description Summary

The Staff Software Engineer will serve as a technical leader for test automation and Continuous Testing across CT software products. This role is responsible for defining the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for scalable automation frameworks and platforms that enable reliable, repeatable, and efficient software verification.
The individual will lead the design and evolution of automation solutions using technologies such as Squish, Selenium, BDD frameworks, and CI/CD platforms. The role requires deep technical expertise, hands on software development capabilities, and the ability to guide globally distributed engineering teams toward common automation standards, framework guidelines, and engineering practices.
The Staff Software Engineer will work across product, software, verification, systems, architecture, and DevOps teams to improve automation coverage, test reliability, execution efficiency, and Continuous Testing adoption. The individual will influence technical decisions across multiple teams and product lines while ensuring that automation platforms remain scalable, maintainable, reusable, and aligned with product and business roadmaps.

Job Description

In this role, you will:

• Serve as the technical leader for the test automation team, providing technical direction, architecture guidance, and hands on support for complex automation challenges.

• Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the Continuous Testing platform across multiple CT products and software configurations.

• Lead the design, development, integration, and maintenance of scalable automation frameworks using Squish, Selenium, BDD, and other appropriate automation technologies.

• Establish a common automation architecture that supports desktop, web, service, and hybrid application workflows.

• Provide technical leadership for automating complex desktop applications, including applications built using Java Swing and applications containing embedded browser technologies.

• Drive the integration of Squish and Selenium automation into a unified Continuous Testing platform that supports reliable end to end workflow verification.

• Define and enforce automation development guidelines, framework standards, coding practices, review criteria, tagging conventions, reporting requirements, and test reliability expectations.

• Influence globally distributed software and verification teams to adopt common automation frameworks, reusable components, engineering practices, and Continuous Testing guidelines.

• Partner with global teams to understand product specific needs while ensuring that locally developed solutions align with the overall platform architecture and long term technical strategy.

• Provide hands on technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, technical deep dives, troubleshooting, and implementation of critical framework components.

• Lead the modernization of existing automation assets, including conversion of legacy Squish tests and older BDD implementations into standardized, maintainable, and reusable automation models.

• Develop reusable automation libraries, services, utilities, and platform capabilities that can be adopted across multiple products and engineering teams.

• Improve automation reliability through effective synchronization, object recognition, environment management, failure recovery, logging, diagnostics, and reporting capabilities.

• Lead technical efforts to distinguish product defects, automation issues, infrastructure failures, configuration problems, and environmental conditions during automated test execution.

• Drive improvements in automated test execution time, parallel execution, resource utilization, configuration based test selection, and overall platform scalability.

• Enable onboarding of Selenium and other automation suites into the Continuous Testing infrastructure.

• Ensure that the Continuous Testing platform supports development testing, integration testing, dry runs, regression testing, and formal verification and validation activities.

• Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams to integrate automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines, build systems, test environments, reporting solutions, and engineering dashboards.

• Establish technical metrics and quality indicators for automation coverage, execution stability, failure trends, test maintainability, and platform performance.

• Identify opportunities to apply AI assisted development and analysis tools to test creation, failure analysis, impact assessment, reporting, and engineering productivity.

• Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Systems Engineers, Verification teams, Software teams, and DevOps teams to translate system and product needs into an actionable automation platform roadmap.

• Evaluate technology choices and make informed recommendations regarding framework architecture, platform evolution, reuse, scalability, maintainability, and build versus buy decisions.

• Provide technical mentorship to automation engineers and software engineers, helping them strengthen their capabilities in framework development, software design, test architecture, debugging, and engineering best practices.

• Facilitate technical alignment across teams, resolve competing technical approaches, and drive decisions that support common engineering goals.

• Proactively identify technical risks, scalability concerns, framework limitations, and adoption barriers, and drive solutions before they affect product delivery.

• Demonstrate end to end ownership of automation capabilities from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, validation, release, adoption, and ongoing support.

Education Qualification

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a STEM major, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics, with a minimum of 7 years of relevant software engineering experience.

A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred.

Required Technical Qualifications

• Extensive experience in software development, software architecture, test automation, or automation platform engineering.

• Demonstrated experience leading the architecture and development of enterprise scale test automation frameworks or Continuous Testing platforms.

• Strong hands on experience with Squish for automating complex desktop applications.

• Strong hands on experience with Selenium for web application automation.

• Experience designing automation solutions using BDD frameworks such as Cucumber or comparable technologies.

• Strong programming experience using one or more languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or C++.

• Experience designing reusable software components, automation libraries, framework services, APIs, and engineering utilities.

• Experience integrating automated test frameworks with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins or comparable pipeline technologies.

• Strong understanding of software design principles, object oriented development, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and scalable system architecture.

• Experience troubleshooting complex automation failures involving the application, framework, infrastructure, network, configuration, test data, or execution environment.

• Experience with source control, code review, build systems, artifact management, automated reporting, and software quality tools.

• Experience with Agile software development, requirements analysis, estimation, planning, and incremental delivery.

• Experience working in a regulated software development environment is preferred.

• Experience with medical device software, clinical workflows, imaging applications, or CT systems is preferred.

Desired Characteristics

Technical Expertise

• Demonstrates deep expertise in automation framework architecture, software design patterns, scalable platform development, and Continuous Testing practices.

• Has the technical depth to lead complex architecture discussions while remaining hands on when critical framework or platform problems require direct involvement.

• Understands the strengths, limitations, and appropriate use of Squish, Selenium, BDD, service level testing, and other automation approaches.

• Designs automation platforms for reliability, extensibility, configurability, maintainability, observability, and reuse.

• Promotes modular framework design and shared components to reduce duplication across products and global teams.

• Establishes effective technical governance without slowing down engineering execution or innovation.

• Leads technical deep dives and architecture reviews across multiple product teams and technology stacks.

• Drives modernization of legacy automation into standardized and maintainable framework patterns.

• Champions Continuous Testing and CI/CD practices that enable faster feedback, improved reliability, and more predictable software delivery.

• Evaluates AI assisted engineering capabilities and applies them where they provide measurable improvements in automation development, failure analysis, impact assessment, or engineering productivity.

• Understands the relationship between automated testing, product risk, requirements traceability, release readiness, and formal verification.

Business Acumen

• Connects automation platform investments with product quality, verification efficiency, release predictability, and customer outcomes.

• Evaluates technology trends and distinguishes sustainable engineering value from short term technology trends.

• Makes informed build versus buy recommendations and clearly articulates technical tradeoffs, cost, maintainability, scalability, and long term value.

• Prioritizes platform capabilities based on business impact, technical risk, product roadmap needs, and adoption potential.

• Understands that a successful automation platform requires both strong technology and consistent adoption by engineering teams.

• Balances immediate product delivery needs with long term framework sustainability and platform evolution.

Leadership

• Leads primarily through technical credibility, influence, collaboration, and consistent engineering judgment.

• Establishes and communicates a clear technical vision for automation and Continuous Testing.

• Influences global teams to adopt common framework standards, development guidelines, and engineering practices.

• Builds alignment across product teams even when priorities, architectures, or existing approaches differ.

• Explains the reasoning behind technical decisions and communicates downstream implications clearly.

• Proactively identifies obstacles affecting automation development, platform adoption, test reliability, or execution efficiency, and leads their resolution.

• Navigates accountability effectively within a global and matrixed organization.

• Facilitates constructive technical discussions and drives decisions when teams have competing approaches or priorities.

• Mentors engineers and develops future technical leaders within the automation organization.

• Creates a shared sense of purpose across software, verification, architecture, infrastructure, and DevOps teams.

• Learns from failures and uses those learnings to improve framework architecture, engineering practices, and technical decision making.

Personal Attributes

• Demonstrates strong critical thinking and can identify patterns across product failures, automation behavior, infrastructure conditions, and engineering processes.

• Communicates complex technical topics clearly to engineers, architects, managers, and other stakeholders.

• Is comfortable operating in ambiguous situations and brings structure, technical direction, and clear decision making.

• Builds trust across global teams and creates alignment without relying on direct reporting authority.

• Maintains a hands on engineering mindset while providing broader technical leadership.

• Challenges existing approaches constructively and recommends practical, sustainable alternatives.

• Demonstrates strong ownership, persistence, curiosity, and accountability.

• Continuously evaluates emerging technologies, tools, and engineering practices that can improve software quality and delivery efficiency.

• Promotes a culture of reuse, automation, engineering excellence, technical learning, and continuous improvement.

• Energizes teams around a common technical vision and maintains momentum when technical or organizational challenges arise.

Job Description Summary

Responsible for the design, development, verification, and maintenance of software solutions that enable safe and effective operation of Computed Tomography (CT) imaging systems. Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering, Clinical Applications, Product Owners, Software Architects, Verification & Validation teams, and global development teams to translate customer, clinical, and workflow requirements into high quality software solutions.

Design, develop, debug, test, and sustain software components across Scanner Desktop, operator workflow, system integration, and related platform services. Participate in architecture discussions, feature design, requirements analysis, impact assessments, code reviews, and technical problem solving. Investigate customer reported issues and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve product quality and reliability.

Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements decomposition, design documentation, implementation, automated testing, verification, release readiness, and post release support. Ensure compliance with medical device software development processes and standards, including traceability, risk management, software FMEA, cybersecurity, and quality system requirements.

Drive engineering excellence through Agile and Lean practices, continuous integration, test automation, code quality improvements, and effective use of modern software development tools and AI enabled productivity solutions. Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to a collaborative, innovative, and customer focused engineering culture.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Design, develop, verify, and maintain software solutions for Computed Tomography (CT) imaging systems, supporting Scanner Desktop applications, clinical workflows, system interfaces, and platform services.

• Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering, Product Owners, Software Architects, Clinical Application teams, Verification & Validation teams, Cybersecurity teams, and global development teams to translate customer and clinical requirements into high quality software solutions.

• Lead the design and implementation of complex software features, evaluate technical approaches, and contribute to architectural decisions across the Scanner Desktop subsystem.

• Perform requirements analysis, impact assessments, software design, coding, debugging, code reviews, testing, and software integration activities throughout the product lifecycle.

• Investigate customer reported issues, software defects, and field escalations, perform root cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve product quality and reliability.

• Apply Agile, Lean, Software FMEA, DevSecOps, and Continuous Integration practices to drive quality, maintainability, and reliability throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Design, develop, test, refactor, and continuously improve software while ensuring compliance with quality, regulatory, and cybersecurity requirements applicable to medical device software.

• Develop and maintain automated tests, improve test coverage, and contribute to automation initiatives that increase engineering productivity and product quality.

• Understand and optimize application performance, scalability, resource utilization, and system reliability.

• Work with core data structures, algorithms, multithreaded applications, distributed systems, and modern software design patterns.

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers, actively contributing to engineering best practices and technical excellence across the team.

• Proactively communicate technical information, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders with the appropriate level of detail and timeliness.

• Demonstrates end-to-end ownership of features from requirements through design, implementation, verification, release, and post-release support.

• Serve as a technical leader for key Scanner Desktop development initiatives, influencing architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, driving technical direction, and ensuring successful delivery of software commitments.


Education Qualification

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or STEM Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) with a minimum of 4 years relevant professional experience.

Desired Characteristics

Technical Expertise:

• Experience with Java, OSGi based applications, Spring Framework, REST APIs, and service oriented architectures.

• Experience with frontend technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Angular, or similar modern UI frameworks.

• Experience developing software in Linux and Windows environments.

• Experience with source control and development tools such as Git, GitLab, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Artifactory, SonarQube, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience with automated testing frameworks, unit testing, integration testing, and test automation.

• Experience writing scripts using Python, Groovy, Shell, or similar scripting languages.

• Knowledge of YAML, JSON, and API driven system integrations.

• Experience debugging complex software issues and performing root cause analysis.

• Familiarity with cybersecurity, secure coding practices, static code analysis, and software quality tools.

• Understanding of software verification, traceability, risk management, and regulated product development environments is preferred.

• Experience in medical device software development is preferred.

• Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools, automation frameworks, and modern engineering productivity solutions is a plus.

•Develop high quality, maintainable, and scalable code that meets engineering standards and delivers desired functionality using the technology selected for the project.


Business Acumen:
